.

with a focus on efficiency and ROI.
Strong understanding of AI and emerging technologies

Ability to operate comfortably at both the strategic and hands-on technical leadership levels

Strong business judgment and executive communication skills.

The Opportunity

This role offers the opportunity to shape the next generation of technology for an established fintech company operating in an environment where security, reliability, and performance are critical

OpenLoop was co-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go-to-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states.

We're building the IT organization from the ground up at OpenLoop Health, a fast-growing telehealth platform scaling our AI-powered care delivery across digital health, brick-and-mortar, and enterprise segments. As Director of IT Operations, you'll lead the operational backbone of our infrastructure designing and scaling systems that reliably support thousands of concurrent patients, clinicians, and partners while maintaining the security and compliance standards required in healthcare.

This is a high-leverage role reporting directly to the VP of Enterprise Technology. You'll build and lead a team of 11 engineers and operators focused on infrastructure reliability, incident response, and leveraging AI to transform IT operations (automation, predictive monitoring, intelligent alerting, and beyond). You'll own IT operations strategy and be instrumental in shaping how AI improves our operational efficiency, reliability, and decision-making.

Manage infrastructure spend and cloud resource optimization (AWS, GCP, or multi-cloud)
Lead technical standardization across development, security, and product teams

AI-Enhanced Operations

Identify and implement AI/ML tools to improve operational efficiency (predictive alerting, anomaly detection, root-cause analysis)
Experiment with AI-driven automation for routine operational tasks
Work with OpenLoop's AI Program to understand how AI can transform IT operations and share learnings
Build a culture of intelligent observability—moving from reactive to predictive operations
Evaluate emerging AI/ML tooling for infrastructure, monitoring, and incident response

AI Program Operations Support

Work alongside the VP of Enterprise Technology to operationalize the AI Program
Define operational requirements for AI model deployment, monitoring, and governance
Establish observability and alerting standards for AI systems at scale
Build operational runbooks and playbooks that enable safe, rapid experimentation

Security & Compliance

Partner with Security to ensure operational practices support SOC 2, HIPAA, and state healthcare compliance
Manage access control, secrets management, and least-privilege architectures
Own disaster recovery and business continuity planning
Lead quarterly compliance audits and remediation workflows

Reliability & Performance

Establish SLAs/SLOs for critical services and own performance against them
Build a culture of blameless postmortems and continuous improvement
Design monitoring, alerting, and observability infrastructure
Lead capacity planning and infrastructure roadmap

Stakeholder Management

Communicate infrastructure health, risks, and roadmap to leadership and cross-functional teams
Support product and engineering teams with infrastructure provisioning and troubleshooting
Manage relationships with vendors and cloud providers
Mentor and develop operational staff

Required

Who You Are

8+ years in IT operations, infrastructure engineering, or site reliability roles
5+ years in a leadership role managing technical teams (5+ direct reports)
Proven experience operating mission-critical SaaS or healthcare platforms
Deep expertise with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and infrastructure-as-code
Strong understanding of HIPAA compliance, security baselines, and healthcare regulations
Experience designing systems for 99.5%+ uptime and handling production incidents
Track record of building strong operational cultures (automation-first, blameless postmortems, on-call excellence)

Background in healthcare (EMR/EHR systems, telehealth platforms, etc.)
Experience supporting machine learning or AI infrastructure at scale
Familiarity with database operations, replication, and backup/recovery strategies
Knowledge of healthcare data architecture and privacy requirements
Startup experience or consulting background
Experience evaluating or implementing AI/ML tooling for operations (predictive alerting, AIOps platforms, etc.)

The Role

We are seeking a visionary, hyper-technical, and battle-tested Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
to join our executive leadership team. Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and working closely with the Board, you will assume absolute ownership of Alpaca’s global cybersecurity posture, information security architectures, and digital asset defense mechanisms.
Operating at the critical intersection of high-throughput trading APIs, autonomous AI agent operations, and multi-chain asset tokenization, you will safeguard our cloud-native brokerage network. Design and govern security perimeters tailored for AI-driven trading agents, real-time algorithmic execution, cryptographic keys, smart contract ledger interactions, and asset tokenization networks.
Regulatory Compliance & Financial Audits:
Enforce robust security baselines that map directly to FINRA, SEC, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and global financial standards

Incident Response & Threat Intelligence:
Direct our 24/7 Security Operations Center (SOC) telemetry, orchestrate advanced automated threat hunting against state-sponsored and financially motivated actors, and stress-test recovery plans via Red Teaming.
Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM):
Oversee exhaustive risk screening across our global financial vendors, banking rails, market data feeds, and custody providers.
Executive Advisory & Culture:
Translate complex threat landscapes and technical security metrics into clear strategic choices for the Board of Directors, Audit Committees, and global partners. Foster a data-secure culture within our fully remote workforce.

12+ years of progressive professional experience in information security or systems engineering, with at least 5+ years in an executive security leadership capacity (CISO, Deputy CISO, or VP of Security) within a self-clearing broker-dealer, high-frequency trading firm, top-tier FinTech, or major crypto exchange

Deep conceptual and practical understanding of clearing and settlement lifecycles, API security models, cryptographic key management (HSMs, MPC), and multi-signature infrastructure.

new_jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About The Role:

We’re looking for a VP-level AI Architect to define and drive a consistent, modern AI- and agentic-first architecture across CrowdStrike. This company-wide role spans business units, customer-facing products, shared platforms, and internal AI capabilities.

You’ll connect AI applications with the software and infrastructure that make them work at scale. Working with business unit and engineering leaders, you’ll translate business priorities into practical designs, establish common technical foundations, and guide implementation across teams. The architecture must support distinct product needs while making shared capabilities easier to build, integrate, and operate.

Your work will range from company-wide architectural decisions to building reference implementations and resolving difficult engineering problems. You’ll bring deep systems expertise, sound judgment about emerging AI technologies, and a record of turning architectural direction into working products.

What You’ll Do:

Define and drive the company-wide AI architecture and roadmap. Establish shared interfaces and design patterns, resolve cross-business-unit tradeoffs, and work with product and engineering leaders to put architectural decisions into practice. Determine which capabilities should be common and where teams need flexibility.
Design and build full-stack AI and agentic systems. Connect models and retrieval to agent runtimes, memory, tools, and execution environments. Develop prototypes and production reference implementations that give teams a tested foundation for new capabilities.
Architect production AI systems for performance, resilience, and scale. Benchmark model and serving options, investigate bottlenecks across software and infrastructure, and improve latency, throughput, and compute efficiency. Guide deployment choices across cloud and edge environments.
Create a consistent developer experience across products through reusable components, common APIs, and shared tooling. Simplify integration and establish engineering practices that teams adopt. Contribute to critical implementations, review designs and code, and mentor engineers and technical leaders.
Design the AI lifecycle architecture, from data ingestion and model adaptation through evaluation, deployment, and operational feedback. Establish reproducible workflows, automated quality gates, and observability for model quality, agent task success, reliability, and cost. Build safe rollout, rollback, and recovery into production systems.
Embed security, governance, and auditability into AI architectures. Define permissions and execution boundaries for agents, address prompt injection and data exposure, and make system actions traceable. Partner with Security and Legal to translate requirements into practical engineering controls.

What You’ll Need:

BS, MS, or PhD in computer science, computer engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
10+ years of experience in software architecture, systems engineering, or AI engineering, including senior technical leadership across multiple products or business units.
A record of personally designing and delivering production AI systems, including generative or agentic applications and the infrastructure that supports them.
Strong foundations in distributed systems, software design, APIs, and performance engineering, with the ability to work across application and infrastructure layers.
Practical experience with model integration, inference serving, retrieval, and evaluation, including the tradeoffs involved in deploying and operating AI systems at scale.
Experience establishing shared platforms and engineering standards across independent teams. Ability to align senior stakeholders, explain architectural tradeoffs, and mentor engineers through implementation.
Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:

Significant contributions to open-source projects or industry standards, with experience shaping technical direction across external engineering communities and partners.
Depth in Linux systems software, networking, accelerated computing, or AI deployment across cloud and edge environments.
Experience modernizing established platforms into AI-native systems, particularly in cybersecurity or other environments with demanding security and reliability requirements.
